name: Favicons
description: Generates favicon and app-icon variants plus a web app manifest from one uploaded PNG and injects the icon/manifest markup into the page head.
project_description: Favicons lets a site administrator upload a single source PNG and automatically derive the favicon and app-icon set a modern site needs: a 96x96 icon, a 180x180 apple-touch-icon, a base64-embedded /favicon.svg endpoint, and a /site.webmanifest describing the icons, site name, theme colour and background colour. Derivatives are produced through core Image styles (96x96, 180x180). The module implements hook_page_attachments() to inject the icon <link> tags and the manifest reference into the <head> of every page, and it installs itself with a very high module weight so those tags override any theme-provided favicon markup. Configuration lives in the favicons.settings config object and is edited on a single settings form at /admin/config/search/favicons, gated by the 'administer favicons' permission. Two lightweight public routes (/favicon.svg and /site.webmanifest) render the SVG wrapper and the JSON manifest on demand. The module has no external dependencies, no submodules and no third-party libraries.
